target.title: feat: add guarded FakeCo AWS owner
target.body:
## Summary

- add a guarded FakeCo-only CloudFormation owner for one private ARM64 ClickClack VM in the dedicated member account
- reuse an explicitly supplied VPC, private subnet, and active egress path; allow TCP 8080 only from approved source security groups
- add protected manual plan/apply/verify/teardown operations with exact account, network, AMI, storage, security-group, and workload-IAM replay
- add deterministic SSM bootstrap, seed equality, health/readiness, metadata-only metrics, runtime identity, SQLite backup/integrity, restore, and retained-data teardown proof
- document the account foundation, exact Environment inputs, costs, durations, canary handoff, restore procedure, and disposal boundary

Production Cloudflare Worker, Container, Postgres, R2, domains, release, and version paths are unchanged.

## Safety boundary

- `plan` is the default and never executes its change set
- `apply` rejects resource removals and actual or conditional replacement
- no public IP, SSH key, port 22 rule, VPC, subnet, route table, NAT gateway, load balancer, or DNS resource is created
- the instance role is inline-policy-only, permissions-boundary constrained, and limited to SSM plus exact artifact/log/backup/KMS destinations
- verify and teardown fail closed on live instance, volume, security-group, instance-profile, trust-policy, boundary, tag, and inline-policy drift
- teardown takes a fresh hot backup and encrypted snapshot, retains the root volume and versioned manifest, and contains no implicit data-delete path
- workflow inputs contain identifiers only; no GitHub or application secret values are added

## Validation

Exact candidate: `e36ef7cacbe6a132691130c9b79045c8e2f76211` / tree `95e24fb25604b59ef05435295b5c2e74a48ea517`.

Diff: 12 files, 3,838 insertions, 24 deletions; SHA-256 `37ef1d6e2bfa1e6d441312f4b7bab4c0a23c28f6e773b54536e2eba0d3fb5049`.

- `pnpm check`
- `pnpm docs:site`
- `pnpm coverage` — 86.5%
- `pnpm test:e2e` — 46 passed
- `actionlint .github/workflows/fakeco-aws.yml`
- `shellcheck deploy/fakeco/aws/bootstrap.sh`
- `uvx --from cfn-lint cfn-lint deploy/fakeco/aws/template.json`
- exact-head Docker buildx `linux/arm64` and `linux/amd64` builds, cache-only with no registry output
- Ubuntu 24.04 `linux/arm64` behavior proof — Noble has no `awscli` apt candidate; the checksum-pinned official AWS CLI 2.35.20 archive installs and reports `aarch64`
- source-blind local owner behavior validation — satisfies contract, confidence 0.96; valid render, invalid Region, invalid trust boundary, AWS-owned tag replay, and unexpected customer-tag rejection covered
- canonical autoreview — clean, zero actionable findings, confidence 0.82

## Review repairs

- replaced the unavailable Noble `awscli` apt dependency with a versioned official ARM64 archive whose SHA-256 was derived after verifying the AWS CLI Team signature
- accept reserved CloudFormation `aws:` tags during live stack/workload-role replay while retaining exact rejection of every unexpected customer-owned tag
- removed the release-owned changelog edit

Public Model Identifier Gate: **PASS**. Candidate diff, source archive, tests, fixtures/snapshots, workflow, generated evidence, and planned public proof have zero blocking unknown identifiers. The model-bearing canary example uses a public provider identifier documented by [OpenAI](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5), and the compound router syntax is documented by [ClawRouter](https://github.com/openclaw/clawrouter/blob/main/docs/openclaw.md).

## Remaining live-proof gate

No AWS resource, GitHub Environment, secret, account, release, tag, or registry artifact was created while preparing this PR. A read-only availability audit found no configured `fakeco` Environment and no authenticated member-account identity, so merge remains gated on redacted authenticated account preflight and CloudFormation plan plus live apply/verify, backup/restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown proof after the service identity and protected Environment are available. The manual workflow must not be dispatched and this PR must not merge until that external gate is satisfied or the owner gives an explicit item-specific waiver.
